attributes.name: annotation

attributes.name: drift
attributes.description: Sets the amount of variation per voice. The variation slightly affects different aspects of the voice's sound, such as the pitch and filter cutoff. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: env1attack
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel from the initial value to the peak. [0., 60.]

attributes.name: env1decay
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel from the peak to the sustain level. [0., 60.]

attributes.name: env1release
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel back to zero after a note ends. [0.01, 60.]

attributes.name: env1sustain
attributes.description: The level reached at the end of the decay stage until the note ends. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: env2attack
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel from the initial value to the peak. [0., 60.]

attributes.name: env2decay
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel from the peak to the sustain level. [0., 60.]

attributes.name: env2freq
attributes.description: Sets the frequency of the cycling envelope in Hz. [0.17, 1700.]

attributes.name: env2hold
attributes.description: Sets how long the cycling envelope will stay at its maximum level. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: env2mode
attributes.description: Enables/disables whether envelope 2 functions as a cycling envelope.

attributes.name: env2release
attributes.description: Time in seconds needed to travel back to zero after a note ends. [0.01, 60.]

attributes.name: env2sustain
attributes.description: The level reached at the end of the decay stage until the note ends. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: env2tilt
attributes.description: Sets the midpoint of the cycling envelope. At very low or high values, this also affects the envelope's slopes. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: filtermod1amount
attributes.description: Modulates the low-pass filter frequency using the selected modulation source. If set to 1, the modulation creates a frequency shift of approximately nine octaves. [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: filtermod2amount
attributes.description: Modulates the low-pass filter frequency using the selected modulation source. If set to 1, the modulation creates a frequency shift of approximately nine octaves. [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: filtermodsrc1
attributes.description: Sets a modulation source to modulate the low-pass filter cutoff frequency.

attributes.name: filtermodsrc2
attributes.description: Sets a modulation source to modulate the low-pass filter cutoff frequency.

attributes.name: filtertracking
attributes.description: Sets the amount of filter modulation based on which note is played. [0., 1.]

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: gain
attributes.description: Sets the overall volume of the instrument in dB. [-70.6, 0.]

attributes.name: glidetime
attributes.description: Adjusts the time in seconds that overlapping notes take to slide their pitch to the next incoming pitch. Glide is only available if the voice mode is set to mono and notes are played legato. [0., 2.]

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hpfreq
attributes.description: Defines the high-pass filter's cutoff frequency center. [10., 20500.]

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ins
attributes.description: Declares additional inlets that can be used to control float-type attributes at either event or signal rate. Any declared attributes already mapped to inlets will be ignored. This attribute can only be set when the object is instantiated.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: legato
attributes.description: Enables/disables whether triggering a new voice will change its pitch without retriggering the envelopes. Legato is only available if the voice mode is set to mono.

attributes.name: lfoamount
attributes.description: Adjusts the amount of LFO modulation applied to incoming signals. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: lfofreq
attributes.description: Sets the rate of the LFO in Hz. [0.17, 1700.]

attributes.name: lfomodamount
attributes.description: Sets how much the LFO amount if modulated by the selected modulation source. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: lfomodsrc
attributes.description: Sets a source to modulate the LFO amount.

attributes.name: lforetrigger
attributes.description: Enables/disables LFO retrigger. When enabled, the LFO restarts at the same phase position each time a note is triggered.

attributes.name: lfoshape
attributes.description: Select from among several LFO waveforms. The one-shot waveforms turn the LFO into a one-shot decay envelope.

attributes.name: lpfreq
attributes.description: Defines the low-pass filter's cutoff frequency center. [20., 20000.]

attributes.name: lpres
attributes.description: Sets the resonance of the low-pass filter. [0., 1.1]

attributes.name: modamt1
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation from modulator 1 [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: modamt2
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation from modulator 2 [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: modamt3
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation from modulator 3 [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: moddst1
attributes.description: Sets the target of modulator 1

attributes.name: moddst2
attributes.description: Sets the target of modulator 2

attributes.name: moddst3
attributes.description: Sets the target of modulator 3

attributes.name: modsrc1
attributes.description: Sets the source for modulator 1.

attributes.name: modsrc2
attributes.description: Sets the source for modulator 2.

attributes.name: modsrc3
attributes.description: Sets the source for modulator 3.

attributes.name: noiseenable
attributes.description: Enables/disables the noise generator.

attributes.name: noisefilter
attributes.description: Enables/disables filter for the noise generator.

attributes.name: noisegain
attributes.description: Sets the gain of the noise generator in dB. [-70.6, 6.]

attributes.name: notepitchbend
attributes.description: Enables/disables per-note pitch bend.

attributes.name: osc1enable
attributes.description: Enables/disables oscillator 1

attributes.name: osc1filter
attributes.description: Enables/disables filter for oscillator 1

attributes.name: osc1gain
attributes.description: Sets the Oscillator 1 gain in dB. If filter processing is on, high oscillator gain values can cause the filters to recreate some of the behaviors found in analog circuits. [-70.6, 6.]

attributes.name: osc1octave
attributes.description: Transpose oscillator 1 in octave increments. [-2, 3]

attributes.name: osc1shape
attributes.description: Morphs the shape of the Oscillator 1 waveform. The shaping effect changes depending on the selected waveform. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: osc1shapemod
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation of osc1_shape by osc1shapemodsrc. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: osc1shapemodsrc
attributes.description: Select the modulation source for osc1_shape.

attributes.name: osc1type
attributes.description: Sets the oscillator 1 waveform shape.

attributes.name: osc2detune
attributes.description: Sets the pitch of Oscillator 2 in semitones in relation to the global transpose attribute. [-7., 7.]

attributes.name: osc2enable
attributes.description: Enables/disables oscillator 2

attributes.name: osc2filter
attributes.description: Enables/disables filter for oscillator 2

attributes.name: osc2gain
attributes.description: Sets the Oscillator 2 gain in dB. If filter processing is on, high oscillator gain values can cause the filters to recreate some of the behaviors found in analog circuits. [-70.6, 6.]

attributes.name: osc2octave
attributes.description: Transpose oscillator 2 in octave increments. [-2, 3]

attributes.name: osc2type
attributes.description: Sets the oscillator 2 waveform shape.

attributes.name: oscmod1amount
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation of both oscillators from oscmod1src. [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: oscmod2amount
attributes.description: Sets the amount of modulation of both oscillators from oscmod2src. [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: oscmodsrc1
attributes.description: Select a modulation source to modulate the pitch of both oscillators.

attributes.name: oscmodsrc2
attributes.description: Select a modulation source to modulate the pitch of both oscillators.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: pitchbendrange
attributes.description: Sets the global pitch bend range in semitones. [0, 12]

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: retrigger
attributes.description: Enables/disables restarting both oscillators at the same phase position each time a note is triggered.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: stereospread
attributes.description: Sets how much panning variation is applied across individual voices. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.description: Adjusts the relative volume of the 4 mono voices associated with each note. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: transpose
attributes.description: Transpose the instrument's global pitch in semitones. [-48, 48]

attributes.name: unison
attributes.description: Sets how much pitch variation is applied across individual voices. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: velocityvolume
attributes.description: Sets how much the volume is modulated by incoming MIDI note velocity. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: voicemode
attributes.description: Sets the instrument's voice mode. Poly offers polyphonic voicing. Mono offers monophonic voicing. Stereo spreads the voices across the stereo field. Unison slightly detunes each voice independently from one another.

attributes.name: voices
attributes.description: Sets the maximum number of voices that can be played back at the same time. Note that certain voice modes can utilize more voices than notes played.
